name: Corva
description: Corva was a planet in Corva sector's Galaan system. The Galactic Republic established a colony on the planet which was wiped out by clodhoppers which arrived in a grain shipment from Naboo. The clodhoppers ate all the vegetation on Corva as well as 87% of the colonists.
lead_paragraphs: Corva was a planet in Corva sector's Galaan system. The Galactic Republic established a colony on the planet which was wiped out by clodhoppers which arrived in a grain shipment from Naboo. The clodhoppers ate all the vegetation on Corva as well as 87% of the colonists.
